tool.name: RasterToPopulationGrid

param.name: in_rasters
param.dialogReference: Optional local raster file(s) to use instead of (or alongside) auto-download. Leave empty if you enable auto-download below.
param.pythonReference: Optional local raster file(s) to use instead of (or alongside) auto-download. Leave empty if you enable auto-download below.

param.name: download_ghsl
param.dialogReference: Check this to automatically download the population raster from JRC's GHSL open-data server instead of supplying your own file.
param.pythonReference: Check this to automatically download the population raster from JRC's GHSL open-data server instead of supplying your own file.

param.name: epoch
param.dialogReference: The year of population data to download. Only used when auto-download is checked.
param.pythonReference: The year of population data to download. Only used when auto-download is checked.

param.name: coord_system
param.dialogReference: Projection of the GHS-POP raster to download: Mollweide (metric, exact 100 m / 1000 m resolution) or WGS84 (geographic, ~100 m / ~1 km resolution).
param.pythonReference: Projection of the GHS-POP raster to download: Mollweide (metric, exact 100 m / 1000 m resolution) or WGS84 (geographic, ~100 m / ~1 km resolution).

param.name: resolution
param.dialogReference: Pixel size of the raster, dependent on the coordinate system chosen above.
param.pythonReference: Pixel size of the raster, dependent on the coordinate system chosen above.

param.name: download_folder
param.dialogReference: Folder where downloaded rasters are cached so they aren't re-downloaded next time. Defaults to the ArcGIS scratch folder if left empty.
param.pythonReference: Folder where downloaded rasters are cached so they aren't re-downloaded next time. Defaults to the ArcGIS scratch folder if left empty.

param.name: clip_features
param.dialogReference: Polygon feature class used to clip the raster to your study area.
param.pythonReference: Polygon feature class used to clip the raster to your study area.

param.name: out_fc
param.dialogReference: Output feature class path and name. A sensible default is auto-suggested based on the epoch and resolution.
param.pythonReference: Output feature class path and name. A sensible default is auto-suggested based on the epoch and resolution.

param.name: pop_field_name
param.dialogReference: Name of the field holding the (rounded) population value in the output grid.
param.pythonReference: Name of the field holding the (rounded) population value in the output grid.

param.name: set_basemap_crs
param.displayname: Set Basemap Coordinate System to Match Output
param.dialogReference: If checked, sets the active map's coordinate system to match the output at the end, so cells display without distortion.
param.pythonReference: If checked, sets the active map's coordinate system to match the output at the end, so cells display without distortion.

tool.summary: Downloads (optional) and/or merges GHS-POP population raster(s), clips them to a boundary polygon, and converts the result into a vector grid where each cell matches one raster pixel and holds its rounded population value. Zero-population cells are removed and a 5-class Natural Breaks color renderer is applied automatically.
tool.usage:
Enable "Auto-download GHS-POP raster" and select an epoch, coordinate system, and resolution to automatically fetch and cache the population raster, or supply your own local raster(s) in "Input Population Raster(s)" instead. Provide a boundary polygon to clip the raster to your study area, then run the tool. The output grid's cell size exactly matches the source raster's pixel size, with each cell holding the rounded population value of its corresponding pixel. Cells with zero population are removed, and a 5-class Natural Breaks color renderer is applied automatically to the output layer in the active map.

Note: symbology and the optional basemap coordinate system change require the tool to be run from within an open ArcGIS Pro project with an active map.
